This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven evaluation criteria, with the criteria listed along the vertical axis and the count of participants along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Criterion,” lists categories in descending order of participant count: “Relevant FCs” (6 participants), “FC Summary” (5), “Relevance Explanation” (3), “Clarity and Simplicity” (3), “Overall Summary” (2), “Filters” (1), and “Veracity Explanation” (1). The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each bar is colored differently: “Relevant FCs” is dark purple, “FC Summary” is dark blue, “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” are medium teal, “Overall Summary” is light green, and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” are lime green. The bars are sorted in descending order by participant count, with the longest bar at the top and the shortest at the bottom, and each bar has its exact participant count labeled at its right end.
